title: Lush Cave + The Mist
description: Hypixel Skyblock - Turns "The Mist" into a Lush Cave Theme!
body:
This Resourcepack was made for **Hypixel Skyblock**!

This Pack is turning "The Mist" (Dwarven Mines where the Ghosts are located) into a Lush Cave Theme!
This means that, for example, many block textures are replaced by Deepslate and Moss.

I use it to relax my eyes, or simply for a change of pace while grinding for Ghost Bestiary.

_Visit the [gallery](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/lush-mist/gallery) tab to see ingame screenshots!_
